content.text: Digital creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable face significant challenges when trying to sell their products online. This guide provides a robust infrastructure solution that bypasses these restrictions, allowing you to sell your digital products seamlessly. With the right tools and processes in place, you can maintain full ownership and control over your business while minimizing fees. Let’s get started.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Conventional platforms like Gumroad and PayPal impose restrictions that can cripple your ability to sell digital products. They charge high fees; for instance, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference can significantly impact your profits. For example, selling just 100 products a month at $97 each results in a $921 retention difference. This infrastructure allows you to sell directly to your customers, using cryptocurrency which is not only accessible but also typically incurs lower fees. By owning your stack, you secure your revenue stream against the whims of payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To effectively set up your digital commerce stack, you need a few essential components. First, select a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, you will require backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle requests efficiently. For order storage, use Supabase or Google Sheets. You'll also need a file delivery system, which can be achieved using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Collectively, these tools form a robust foundation that enables you to manage and deliver your digital products without reliance on traditional platforms.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you've chosen your components, the next step is to create a seamless payment and delivery pipeline. Start by configuring your payment gateway with NOWPayments, ensuring you can accept multiple cryptocurrencies. Set up a webhook to automate order confirmation and product delivery. This can be done through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, allowing you to automatically trigger file downloads upon receiving payment. Ensure that your cryptocurrency pricing is securely integrated to reflect real-time conversions. With everything connected, you can efficiently manage orders and deliver products instantly, greatly enhancing customer satisfaction.
Retain more profit by reducing transaction fees to just 0.5%.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your stack, test your entire infrastructure before going live. Ensure that all links work, payment processing is smooth, and file delivery is accurately triggered. Run a few test transactions to verify that the entire system functions as expected. Once satisfied, promote your store link to your audience. Monitor the first few transactions closely to identify any potential issues. This initial phase is crucial for fine-tuning your setup and ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is live and running smoothly, consider scaling your operations. Start by adding more products to your inventory. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates for quicker deployment. Explore marketing strategies to reach a broader audience, leveraging social media and email marketing campaigns. As your sales volume increases, monitor your backend performance to ensure it can handle the traffic. Investing in optimizing your stack will facilitate smoother operations and better user experiences as your customer base grows.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Own your entire digital commerce stack — no subscriptions, no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Select your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Choose backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions and configure automatic webhooks for order fulfillment. Test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly before launching. Promote your digital store link to your audience.

How can I sell digital products without using traditional platforms?

You can sell digital products by building your own infrastructure using tools like NOWPayments for payment processing and GitHub Pages for hosting. This allows you to avoid fees and retain full control over your sales.
What are the steps to set up a digital store?

Start by choosing a hosting provider, then set up backend logic for order management. Integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments and automate your delivery pipeline. Finally, test your setup and launch your store.
Are there fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This can help you retain more profit from each sale.
What products can I sell with this infrastructure?
You can sell a variety of digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, and software. This infrastructure is designed to accommodate any digital product.
Is customer data secure with this setup?
Yes, with this infrastructure, you maintain full ownership of customer data after deployment. There are no third-party platforms involved, ensuring data security.
